questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '÷' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '+' are interchanged?

97 + 70 - 35 × 5 ÷ 4 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: 97 + 70 - 35 × 5 ÷ 4 = ?

According to the question, after '÷' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '+' are interchanged:

97 + 70 - 35 × 5 ÷ 4 = ? ⇒ 97 × 70 ÷ 35 + 5 - 4 = ?

⇒ 97 × __**70 **____**÷**____** 35**__ + 5 - 4 = ?

⇒ __**97 × 2**__ + 5 - 4 = ?

⇒ __**194**____** + 5**__ - 4 = ?

⇒ __**199**____** - 4**__ = ?

⇒ 195 = ?

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some saucers are plates.

No plate is a bowl.

No plate is a fork.

**Conclusions:**

(I): No saucer is a bowl.

(II): Some forks are bowls.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c66c154213172228ae54e94d1b478a25f99c32fa63ac4e1a9feebbfacb9519f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No saucer is a bowl → False (As some saucers are plates and no plate is a bowl. As no direct relation is given between saucer and bowl, therefore it is false.)

II. Some forks are bowls. → False (as no plate is a bowl and no plate is a fork. As no direct relation is given between fork and bowl, therefore it is false.)

Thus, Neither I nor II follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting to the immediate left of Q and immediate right of O. M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of L. P is sitting to the immediate left of L and immediate right of N. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Q and P?
questions.solution:
Given: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R is sitting to the immediate left of Q and immediate right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5dadfba2ad1d99cb8eb8753148ee8a3157a933f4dd7d305c7522f46aba7af79.png] 

2) M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02f120a58295f4abb37609d567461c0c0133ec36aaaa2713e68b3aeb5f99d09c.png] 

3) P is sitting to the immediate left of L and immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9f8b3c6ddf7b6fd284b8a5e4c2bdf0ece8997f6592214880c216aba60d6d51.png] 

Thus, N is the immediate neighbour of both Q and P.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Seven persons, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row facing north. (But not necessarily in the same order.

No one sits to the left of B. Only four persons sit between B and N. Only three persons sit to the right of L. M sits immediate left of S. A is not the immediate neighbour of L. Who sits third to the left of A?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven persons, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of B.

2) Only four persons sit between B and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/044f0dc970a091a5f1802b2efc1d57bf0139f6f41301eb1673d553499c713297.png] 

3) Only three persons sit to the right of L.

4) M sits immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95c0234f923d7e35ea8e7d1beb0484d7cfe50703eb1f4b35e4a207c5340c7f14.png] 

5) A is not the immediate neighbour of L.

After positioning A only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4b6fb34ffaae1f261cdfc4892a8ce73f0749cb0251e5c645dea4fd2e96804db.png] 

Thus, L sits third to the left of A.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
